primary_formula: rating ~ episode + group + z_RMS + z_CF + z_SW + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | stimulus_id)
si_formula: rating ~ episode + group + z_RMS + z_CF + z_SW + z_SI + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | stimulus_id)
bounded_sensitivity_formula: rating_01 ~ episode + group + z_RMS + z_CF + z_SW + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | stimulus_id)

icc_outputs.primary_feature: conditional / final-model ICC from the primary feature model posterior
icc_outputs.si_sensitivity: conditional / final-model ICC from the SI sensitivity posterior
icc_outputs.unconditional_feature_icc: not fitted or exported by this module

bounded_sensitivity_status: fitted transformed-Beta sensitivity model after Smithson-Verkuilen adjustment for exact 0/100 ratings; coefficients are on logit/proportion scale, not native rating points
final_gate: REAL FEATURE MODEL READY FOR DISSERTATION RESULTS SECTION
